from pathlib import Path
from copy import deepcopy
from unittest.mock import patch
import hashlib,json,os,sys
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_formats import parser_component
from company_wiki.source_contract import source_id_for_sha256
from company_wiki.source_catalog import narrative_evidence as ne,narrative_retrieval as nr
assert Path(nr.__file__).resolve()==Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()/'src/company_wiki/source_catalog/narrative_retrieval.py'
owned=Path(sys.argv[1]);cases=[]
sentence='We launched a new manufacturing product and expanded overseas capacity.'
original=('Full Conference Call Transcript\nCEO: '+sentence+'\n').encode()
def fixture(name):
 raw=owned/(name+'.txt');raw.write_bytes(original);digest=hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest();source=source_id_for_sha256(digest)
 pname,pver=parser_component('text/plain','transcript',parser_version='0.2.0')
 parsed=ne.parse_transcript_text(original.decode(),source_id=source,source_sha256=digest,parser_version=pver,language='en')
 selected=ne.select_narrative_evidence(parsed,title='Independent manufacturing earnings call',existing_kind='investor_call_transcript')
 bundle={'schema_version':nr.NARRATIVE_EVIDENCE_BUNDLE_SCHEMA_VERSION,'sources':[{'title':'Independent manufacturing earnings call','selection_status':selected.status,'coverage_complete':selected.coverage_complete,'summary_input':selected.summary_input(),'replay_contract':{'schema_version':nr.NARRATIVE_REPLAY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,'source_format':'transcript_txt','language':'en','existing_kind':'investor_call_transcript','parser_name':pname,'parser_version':pver,'parser_options':{},'selector_name':ne.NARRATIVE_SELECTOR_NAME,'selector_version':ne.NARRATIVE_SELECTOR_VERSION,'max_selected':selected.selection_limit}}]}
 return raw,bundle,nr.NarrativeEvidenceSearch(bundle).search('manufacturing product')[0]
def mutate(bundle,kind):
 record=bundle['sources'][0];row=record['summary_input']['evidence'][0];contract=record['replay_contract']
 if kind=='version':contract['parser_version']='9.9.9'
 elif kind=='supported_mismatch':contract['parser_version']='0.1.1'
 elif kind in {'text','text_with_sha'}:
  row['raw_text']='We launched a fabricated different business.'
  if kind=='text_with_sha':row['raw_text_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(row['raw_text'].encode()).hexdigest()
 elif kind=='locator':row['locators'][0]='loc:v1/paragraph:999/chars:0-4'
 elif kind=='source_sha':record['summary_input']['source_sha256']='0'*64
 elif kind=='selector':contract['selector_version']='9.9.9'
 elif kind=='options':contract['parser_options']['unrecognized']=True
for when in ['before_first_read','after_first_read']:
 for kind in ['version','supported_mismatch','text','text_with_sha','locator','source_sha','selector','options']:
  raw,bundle,hit=fixture(when+'-'+kind);paths={hit.source_id:raw};initial=deepcopy(bundle['sources'][0]);resolver=nr.NarrativeEvidenceResolver(bundle,raw_paths_by_source_id=paths)
  parse_calls=[];hash_calls=[];parse_original=ne.parse_transcript_text;hash_original=nr._sha256_file
  def count_parse(*args,**kwargs):
   parse_calls.append(kwargs['parser_version']);return parse_original(*args,**kwargs)
  def count_hash(path):
   hash_calls.append(str(path));return hash_original(path)
  with patch.object(ne,'parse_transcript_text',count_parse),patch.object(nr,'_sha256_file',count_hash):
   first=resolver.resolve(hit) if when=='after_first_read' else None
   mutate(bundle,kind);paths.clear();current=resolver.resolve(hit);grouped=resolver.resolve_group(source_id=hit.source_id,evidence_group_id=hit.evidence_group_id)
   assert current==grouped and (first is None or first==current)
   assert current.raw_text==sentence and current.parser_version=='0.2.0'
   assert resolver._records[hit.source_id]==initial and resolver._records[hit.source_id] is not bundle['sources'][0]
   assert parse_calls==['0.2.0'] and len(hash_calls)==(4 if when=='after_first_read' else 3)
  fresh=nr.NarrativeEvidenceResolver(bundle,raw_paths_by_source_id={hit.source_id:raw})
  try:fresh.resolve(hit)
  except nr.NarrativeEvidenceResolveError as exc:reason=str(exc)
  else:raise AssertionError('new reader accepted '+kind)
  cases.append({'name':when+'-'+kind,'passed':True,'parser_calls_existing_reader':len(parse_calls),'sha_calls_existing_reader':len(hash_calls),'existing_snapshot_equals_original':True,'existing_parser':'0.2.0','external_path_map_cleared':True,'new_reader_refused':True,'new_reader_reason':reason})
raw,bundle,hit=fixture('raw-cache-integrity');resolver=nr.NarrativeEvidenceResolver(bundle,raw_paths_by_source_id={hit.source_id:raw});stat=raw.stat();parse_original=ne.parse_transcript_text;parse_calls=[]
def count_parse(*args,**kwargs):
 parse_calls.append(kwargs['parser_version']);return parse_original(*args,**kwargs)
with patch.object(ne,'parse_transcript_text',count_parse):
 first=resolver.resolve(hit);changed=original.replace(b'overseas',b'domestic');assert len(changed)==len(original) and changed!=original;raw.write_bytes(changed);refusals=[]
 for operation in [lambda:resolver.resolve(hit),lambda:resolver.resolve_group(source_id=hit.source_id,evidence_group_id=hit.evidence_group_id)]:
  try:operation()
  except nr.NarrativeEvidenceResolveError as exc:
   assert 'raw source SHA-256' in str(exc);refusals.append(str(exc))
  else:raise AssertionError('cached reader accepted changed raw bytes')
 raw.write_bytes(original);os.utime(raw,ns=(stat.st_atime_ns,stat.st_mtime_ns))
 assert resolver.resolve(hit)==first and resolver.resolve_group(source_id=hit.source_id,evidence_group_id=hit.evidence_group_id)==first
 assert parse_calls==['0.2.0'] and raw.read_bytes()==original and raw.stat().st_mtime_ns==stat.st_mtime_ns
cases.append({'name':'cached-raw-change-refusal-and-exact-restoration','passed':True,'same_length_bytes_changed':True,'resolve_and_group_refused':True,'refusal_reasons':refusals,'restored_result_equals_original':True,'raw_sha_and_mtime_restored':True,'parser_calls':1})
print(json.dumps({'cases':cases,'case_count':len(cases),'all_passed':True,'external_requests':0,'paid_calls':0},ensure_ascii=False))
